name: Film Dissolve
notes: Luma-aware cross dissolve with a soft bloom lift at midpoint. The gold default.

name: Whip Pan
notes: Directional swipe with heavy motion blur; keep direction consistent between cuts.

name: Light Leak Wipe
notes: Warm orange leak band sweeps the frame; the incoming shot glows through it.

name: Zoom Punch
notes: Outgoing frame punches through the lens into the next. One per 4 bars max.

name: Glitch Cut
notes: 3-frame RGB-split hard cut. Accent only - never twice in a row.

name: Luma Fade
notes: Both frames lift through near-white; gentler cousin of the hard white flash.

name: Film Burn
notes: Exposure burn-through with gate flicker, like celluloid catching light.

name: Slide Push
notes: Incoming card pushes the previous one out with a spring overshoot.

name: Blur Dissolve
notes: Focus melts from one memory into the next. Beautiful at the final cut.

name: Spin Blur
notes: Quarter-turn rotational blur. Use sparingly, once per edit at most.

name: Soft Mask Wipe
notes: Angled soft-edge wipe; reads premium and calm.

name: Prismatic Shift
notes: RGB channels separate and recombine across the cut.

name: Heartbeat Cut
notes: Two quick luminance pulses like a heartbeat landing exactly on the cut.

name: Film Gate Flicker
notes: Projector gate weave + exposure flicker bridges the cut like old film threading.

name: Ink Bleed
notes: Dark ink blooms from the center and dissolves into the next memory.
